exposure: Gestational age (at 39 gestational weeks or more)
Providers skilled in operative vaginal delivery
cohort: The study included 82,280 nulliparous women in spontaneous labor with a single, cephalic, term pregnancy (Robson group 1).
finding: Various maternal, obstetrical, and facility-level factors were significantly associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Maternal (age, BMI, marital status, prenatal visits, medical risk), obstetrical (obstetrical risk, labor referral, gestational age ≥39 weeks), and facility-level factors (anesthesia availability, teaching status, fees, EFM, operative vaginal delivery skills) were associated with increased cesarean delivery rates.
